environment.description: Same Ktor 2.3.4 microservice on EKS 1.27. Credential rotation via vault-agent sidecar (60s TTL) means any credential exfiltrated via XXE is expired by the time an attacker could use it. Additionally, the pod runs with a Cilium L7 network policy (CiliumNetworkPolicy CRD) that enforces DNS-based FQDN egress restrictions — only *.internal.corp.net and vault.service.consul are permitted as egress destinations. The Cilium agent (v1.14.2) performs deep packet inspection on DNS queries from the pod and blocks any resolution attempt to external domains. The pod also has a seccomp profile (RuntimeDefault) applied via the PodSecurityAdmission controller in 'enforce' mode, though this primarily restricts syscalls unrelated to networking.
